column1: # CodeQL findings that .github/codeql-gate.sh must not fail on.
# Format, one finding per line, tab-separated:
#   <rule id>
# The line hash is CodeQL's own content fingerprint for the flagged line. It
# survives the file being reshuffled and stops matching the moment the flagged
# line itself changes -- so an entry cannot silently keep excusing rewritten
# code. The gate also fails on entries that match nothing, which forces a fixed
# finding's line to be deleted here rather than left as a permanent hole.
# Every entry needs a reason above it. "CodeQL is noisy" is not a reason.
# False positive. core.py:3298 is `key.startswith("node-role.kubernetes.io/")`,
# and the rule fires on any string literal that parses as a hostname. This one
# is a Kubernetes label-key prefix, not a URL: `key` iterates
# `node.metadata.labels` as returned by the Kubernetes API. The call sits
# directly beside `key.removeprefix("node-role.kubernetes.io/")` -- the intent
# is "strip this prefix", not "authorize this host". Parsing it as a host would
# be less accurate, not more, so this is suppressed rather than rewritten.
py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization
# False positive. api.py:1721 is `re.fullmatch(pattern, path)` inside the
# `match_path` helper. CodeQL treats a parameter of a BaseHTTPRequestHandler
# method as remote-controlled, but `pattern` is a literal raw string at all 23
# call sites; the remote value is `path`, the subject being matched, which is
# not a regex-injection sink. tests/test_route_completeness.py extracts those
# literals from the source and requires the extracted set to equal the OpenAPI
# paths, so a non-literal pattern would drop a route from the set and fail that
# test.
py/regex-injection
# False positive. The sink is the rollback arm of `_swap_in_restored_tree`,
# where `name` comes from `staging.iterdir()` -- a single directory-entry name,
# which cannot contain a path separator. The taint source CodeQL follows is
# `_safe_relative`, which already rejects absolute paths, `..` components and
# the reserved `.sandbox` root before anything is written. CodeQL does not model
# `PurePosixPath.parts` inspection as a sanitizer.
py/path-injection
# False positive. `Math.random()` in the console's mock backend, used to make a
# display placeholder for an API key. `api.ts` selects `mockApi` behind the
# build-time constant `VITE_USE_MOCK`, so production bundles drop the module
# entirely; no backend ever accepts the value. See the comment above `USE_MOCK`
# in console/src/api.ts for the standing constraint on mock top-level code.
js/insecure-randomness
